ORCHESTRATOR ADJUDICATION 2026-09-14 — duplicate pair P5405 <-> P4070, decided across both shards.
SAME PROJECT, CONFIRMED. Both row agents reached this independently and the evidence is unambiguous: one Brownsville-to-Greenpoint, 7 mi, 30 in National Grid transmission main (the Metropolitan Reliability Infrastructure / Metropolitan Natural Gas Reliability Project), construction from spring 2017, final phase withdrawn 2023. Identical endpoints, length, diameter and construction year on both rows.
KEEPER: P4070. It carries the geometry (routes repo P4070.geojson holds 5 real features, Company='National Grid', States='NY', with per-phase status attributes; P5405.geojson geometry is null), it carries Capacity (250 MMcf/d) which P5405 lacks entirely, it carries the row's refs, and its LastUpdated is 2025-08-07 against P5405's 2023-07-12. Retiring the geometry-bearing row to keep the empty one would also break the three-way route sync. RECOMMEND: retire/merge P5405 into P4070, carrying across the three things P5405 researched that P4070 did not (FuelSource, the legal operating entity, and the NYSDEC permit-withdrawal ref) - all three are now staged on P4070 itself, so nothing is lost if P5405 is dropped.
CONSIDERED AND REJECTED: re-scoping the two rows as two segments (built phases 1-4 on one, cancelled phase 5 on the other). Nothing in either row's data describes phase 5 alone - both carry the FULL 7 mi / 30 in / Brownsville-Greenpoint line - and no source gives phase 5's own length or endpoints, so the split would have to be invented. The pipe is one row.
STATUS RULED: OPERATING, StartYear1=2020. This is the substantive finding of the pair, and it reverses what the sheet records on BOTH rows. National Grid's own project page states portions were 'placed into service prior to the 2020-2021 heating season' and that the project 'is in service'; the sheet's own existing Earthjustice ref, read in full, credits activists with stopping only phase 5 and describes phases 1-4 as built; In These Times (2023-07) corroborates that the completed sections were physically connected by mid-2023. What was cancelled in 2023 was the fifth phase - the LNG-vaporizer connection at Greenpoint - not the pipeline. Roughly 5.5-6 of the 7 recorded miles exist and carry gas.
CANCELLATION FIELDS RULED: CLEAR CancelledYear (2023) and ShelvedCancelledType ('confirmed') on P4070 when Status moves to operating. Both row agents correctly refused to decide this alone and escalated it. A row cannot be operating and carry a cancellation year: that pairing is exactly the defect class this slice is sweeping for, and it would misreport a built, in-service main as a cancelled project in every downstream count. The 2023 event is real and must not be lost - it is preserved in the Status ref set, in this shard's notes, and in ResearcherNotes, where a partial-scope cancellation belongs. Delayed='yes' / DelayType='confirmed' STAY: the line was proposed to run to Greenpoint and never got there.
